search.query: `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ | stats count
`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ | stats dc(src_ip) AS ips
`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ vendor_action=Interaction | stats dc(src_ip) AS sessions
`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="Rate limit exceeded" | stats count
`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ user=* | stats dc(password) AS creds

chart.title: Attack Volume Over Time by Protocol

search.query: `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ | timechart span=1h count BY transport

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ | stats count AS events, dc(transport) AS protocol_count, values(transport) AS protocols BY src_ip | sort -events | head 15
`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ | stats count BY transport | sort -count

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" (transport=SSH OR transport=TELNET) event.Client=* NOT event.Client="" | stats count AS events, dc(src_ip) AS unique_ips BY event.Client | sort -events | rename event.Client AS client
`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ src_ip=* | iplocation src_ip | geostats latfield=lat longfield=lon count

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ src_ip=* | iplocation src_ip | stats count AS events, dc(src_ip) AS unique_ips BY Country | sort -events | head 15

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ src_ip=* | iplocation src_ip | stats count AS events, dc(src_ip) AS unique_ips BY City, Region, Country | sort -events | head 15
`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ user=* | stats count BY user, password | sort -count | head 20 | rename user AS username

table.title: Credential Spray — IPs Trying Multiple Passwords

search.query: `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" user=* | stats dc(password) AS unique_passwords, dc(user) AS unique_users, count AS attempts BY src_ip | where unique_passwords > 1 | sort -unique_passwords
`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=HTTP | stats count BY http_method, uri_path | sort -count | head 20 | rename http_method AS method, uri_path AS uri

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=HTTP http_user_agent=* NOT http_user_agent="" | stats count AS events, dc(src_ip) AS unique_ips BY http_user_agent | sort -events | head 15 | rename http_user_agent AS user_agent

table.title: LLM Rate Limit — Top Throttled Attackers

search.query: `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="Rate limit exceeded" | stats count AS rate_limited_commands, dc(command) AS unique_commands BY src_ip | sort -rate_limited_commands

table.title: LLM Rate Limit — Top Throttled Commands

search.query: `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="Rate limit exceeded" command=* NOT command="" | stats count AS blocked, dc(client_ip) AS unique_ips BY command | sort -blocked | head 20

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" vendor_action=Interaction command=* NOT command="" | table _time, src_ip, transport, user, command, event.CommandOutput | sort -_time | rename transport AS protocol, event.CommandOutput AS output

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=$protocol_filter$ | table _time, src_ip, src_port, transport, user, password, vendor_action, signature, event_id | sort -_time | rename transport AS protocol, vendor_action AS status, signature AS description
